يتهاون (form VI)
# يَتَهَاوَنُ (yatahāwanu) /ja.ta.haː.wa.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَهَاوَنَ (tahāwana)
# يَتَهَاوَنَّ (yatahāwanna) /ja.ta.haː.wan.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of تَهَاوَنَ (tahāwana)
# يُتَهَاوَنُ (yutahāwanu) /ju.ta.haː.wa.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative
